title: Debian (APT) repository settings
description: The deb member of a repository document. A member lists the classes it applies to in x-trove-classes; a member of another class is refused as not applicable.

architectures.title: Architectures
architectures.description: Architectures every suite's indexes are built for; a local repository adds the architectures of its stored files. 'all' is not listed: the files of that architecture are listed under every architecture of the suite.

compression.title: Compression
compression.description: Index variants built besides gzip, which is always built.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: The Origin field of every Release.

label.title: Label
label.description: The Label field of every Release; the repository key while the document does not set it.

suites.title: Suites
suites.description: Suites a virtual repository serves besides those of its local members.

upstreamKeys.title: Upstream keys
upstreamKeys.description: ASCII-armored OpenPGP public keys of the upstream (one block of 1 to 32 certificates, at most 256 KiB): a remote verifies the signatures of its upstream's release documents against them. Null leaves the remote unverified; a mirror and a member of a virtual repository need them.

mirror.title: Mirror
mirror.description: What a mirror of an APT archive keeps. Present in both modes of a remote repository and effective in mode mirror.

suites.title: Suites
suites.description: Suites (below dists/) to mirror; required in mode mirror.

components.title: Components
components.description: Components whose indexes and package files are kept.

architectures.title: Architectures
architectures.description: Architectures whose Packages indexes and package files are kept; 'all' is always kept and not listed.

sources.title: Source packages
sources.description: Whether Sources indexes and source package files are kept.
